newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish insurer PZU Life net rose 63 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Polish insurer PZU Life net rose 63 pct in 1996.

text.p: Poland's largest life insurance firm Powszechny Zaklad Ubezpieczen na Zycie SA (PZU Zycie) lifted 1996 net profit to 95 million zlotys from 58 million zlotys in 1995, the company said in a statement on Monday.
The company said its technical result rose to 151 million zlotys in 1996 from 141 million in 1995 and revenues from investment grew to 484 million from 406 million in 1995.
The company earlier said its gross premium rose to 2.15 billion zlotys last year from 1.6 billion in 1995.
PZU Zycie, a subsidiary of Poland's largest non-life insurer PZU SA, has 77 percent of the country's life insurance market.
